reply.thought: Before recording any payout, I need to verify that every refund requested in this batch appears in the refunds table with the same amount. W2's report lists order 134 as requested but not as applied, so I'll check the table directly.

The refunds table has orders 130 and 133 but not order 134 ($89.98), which the batch requested. Payouts must not be recorded until every requested refund is found, so I'm stopping the batch for review.
